docs.name: acme/agent-kanban
docs.description: Kanban board for tracking autonomous agent tasks
docs.readme: A kanban board where autonomous agents pull task cards across lists. Each agent claims a task card, moves it to in progress, and drops it in done. Built for multi agent task tracking and backlog grooming on one shared board.

docs.name: acme/actions-json
docs.description: Voice assistant control of any website through a browser extension
docs.readme: Maps site controls into an actions manifest so a voice assistant can operate any website. The browser extension exposes clicks, forms, and navigation to the assistant, giving voice control of arbitrary pages without site cooperation.

docs.name: acme/gitoversight
docs.description: Governance broker holding github writes behind human approval
docs.readme: Every github write flows through the broker. Public pushes need explicit human approval; private branches stay open. Approval gates, audit trails, and brokered credentials for agent mediated github writes.

docs.name: acme/babel3
docs.description: Realtime voice pipeline with speaker diarization and text to speech
docs.readme: Streams microphone audio through transcription, runs speaker diarization to tell voices apart, and speaks replies with neural text to speech. Speaker embeddings enroll each participant into the diarization model, keeping the audio pipeline realtime.

docs.name: acme/searchstore
docs.description: Sqlite cache of repo metadata with full text search and quantized vectors
docs.readme: A rebuildable sqlite database holding repo rows, an fts5 full text index, and int8 quantized embedding vectors for semantic ranking. Everything inside is derived and safe to rebuild.

docs.name: acme/chrome-launcher
docs.description: Launches chrome with a remote debugging port
docs.readme: Finds the chrome binary, prepares a clean profile, and launches chrome with the remote debugging port open so automation can attach over the devtools protocol.

docs.name: acme/hyperframes
docs.description: Render video from html and css compositions
docs.readme: Author scenes as html and css, then render deterministic video frames with a headless engine. Timeline seeking, transitions, and encoding produce the final video file.

docs.name: acme/trello-sync
docs.description: Syncs trello cards with local task files
docs.readme: Two way sync between a trello board and markdown task files. Card moves, list changes, and descriptions replicate in both directions.

docs.name: acme/incident-investigation
docs.description: Structured root cause analysis methodology for production incidents
docs.readme: A ten phase methodology for hypothesis driven debugging: preserve evidence, run experiments, assign blame, and write the postmortem. Root cause analysis with formal anti patterns and remediation planning.

docs.name: acme/codebase-memory
docs.description: Knowledge graph over source code for structural queries
docs.readme: Indexes a repository into a knowledge graph of functions, calls, and dependencies. Run graph queries for callers, call chains, dead code detection, and impact analysis over the source.

docs.name: acme/markdown-parser
docs.description: Fast markdown parser with commonmark compliance
docs.readme: Parses markdown into an abstract syntax tree. Commonmark compliant, with extensions for tables and footnotes. The syntax tree can be walked or rendered.

docs.name: acme/lorem-recipes
docs.description: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet cooking recipes
docs.readme: Sourdough bread needs flour, water, salt, and patience. Roast chicken shines with rosemary and lemon. Pasta carbonara whisks eggs, pecorino, and guanciale. Simmer the ragu slowly. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit, sed do eiusmod tempor.

docs.name: acme/weather-cli
docs.description: Terminal weather forecasts
docs.readme: Prints hourly and weekly forecasts in the terminal with wind, humidity, and precipitation columns.

docs.name: acme/json-schema-validator
docs.description: Validates json documents against json schema drafts
docs.readme: Draft 2020-12 validator with detailed error paths and format assertions.

docs.name: acme/oauth2-proxy
docs.description: Reverse proxy enforcing oauth2 login
docs.readme: Sits in front of upstream services and requires an oauth2 identity before forwarding requests. Supports cookie sessions and header injection.

docs.name: acme/websocket-relay
docs.description: Relays websocket streams between processes
docs.readme: A relay hub that fans websocket frames out to subscribers with backpressure and reconnect handling.

docs.name: acme/image-resizer
docs.description: Batch image resizing service
docs.readme: Resizes and crops images on upload, producing thumbnail and preview variants with caching.

docs.name: acme/log-shipper
docs.description: Ships structured logs to remote sinks
docs.readme: Tails log files, batches records, and ships them to remote sinks with retry and disk buffering.

docs.name: acme/cron-scheduler
docs.description: Distributed cron style job scheduler
docs.readme: Schedules jobs with cron expressions, leader election, and missed run catch up.

docs.name: acme/dns-resolver
docs.description: Caching dns resolver library
docs.readme: Resolves hostnames with caching, negative caching, and configurable upstream servers.

docs.name: acme/ssh-tunnel
docs.description: Manages persistent ssh tunnels
docs.readme: Keeps ssh port forwards alive across network drops with health checks and automatic restarts.

docs.name: acme/rate-limiter
docs.description: Token bucket rate limiting middleware
docs.readme: Per client token bucket limits with burst allowances and shared counters.

docs.name: acme/pdf-extractor
docs.description: Extracts text and tables from pdf files
docs.readme: Pulls text runs and table cells out of pdf documents, preserving reading order.

docs.name: acme/email-templates
docs.description: Transactional email template engine
docs.readme: Composes transactional email with layouts, partials, and inline styling.

docs.name: acme/csv-differ
docs.description: Diffs large csv files by key
docs.readme: Streams two csv files and reports added, removed, and changed rows keyed by chosen columns.

docs.name: acme/redis-queue
docs.description: Reliable job queue on redis
docs.readme: At least once delivery job queue with visibility timeouts, dead letter lists, and consumer groups on redis.

docs.name: acme/terraform-modules
docs.description: Reusable terraform infrastructure modules
docs.readme: Opinionated terraform modules for networks, clusters, and storage buckets with sane defaults.

docs.name: acme/unit-converter
docs.description: Converts between measurement units
docs.readme: Length, mass, temperature, and currency conversions with locale aware formatting.

docs.name: acme/spell-checker
docs.description: Spelling correction library with suggestions
docs.readme: Detects misspelled words and offers ranked suggestions using edit distance and frequency lists.

docs.name: acme/geo-fence
docs.description: Geofencing alerts for moving assets
docs.readme: Watches asset positions and raises alerts when they enter or leave polygon fences.
